first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The tall, slim person on the left with a crew cut, wearing a dark zip-up jacket and dark trousers.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person on the right wearing a dark knit cap, a loose dark leather jacket, a light-colored turtleneck top, and light-colored trousers, with the elbow nearer the center of the image resting on the railing.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The person entering from the left edge, wearing a dark knit cap, a thick coat with a broad light-colored hood-collar and light-colored trim, and camouflage trousers.

entities.name: multistory buildings along the street
entities.identification: The continuous multistory buildings on both sides of the background and the spired building in the distant center.

entities.name: city road
entities.identification: The street at a lower level behind the people, situated between the buildings on both sides and converging toward the distant center.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The light gray sky visible between the buildings in the upper part of the image.

entities.name: dark metal railing
entities.identification: The dark top rail extending horizontally above the parapet and the spaced vertical posts.

entities.name: stone parapet
entities.identification: The horizontal parapet in the lower part of the image, with a broad dark top edge and a mottled light gray wall surface.

entities.name: streetlights along the street
entities.identification: The light fixture in the left background with a broad, flat, dark lamp head and a slender vertical pole.
